name: Build orchestrator
author: Brett
description: Breaks every build into small steps (30 min or less), each pinned to Fable or Opus, and runs the build pipeline (Brett, Nov 8 2026): every build gets an id and a Claude split (Fable only where needed) and sits in Pending; Brett moves it to the Queue; the dispatcher (pipeline.mjs on the VPS, every minute) watches the Claude accounts (which have Fable, parallel per account) and the agent slots and, when a slot is free, starts a headless session for the next Queue build on an account that runs its next phase's model. Page = tab group (Pipeline, Builds, Approvals, Rules); the Pipeline tab shows Pending / Queue / Building, the accounts, what the next tick starts and why the rest waits. Tracker is the one builds store, _claude/builds/store.json, so any session or account continues the build (orchestrator.mjs next | brief | act; pipeline.mjs status | queue | unqueue | split | tick). Queues (Brett, Nov 9 2026): several named queue lists (Main on subscriptions, API on API keys, any he makes), each with its accounts, max parallel, priority, default model and cost cap; rules for overflow, routing and max cost per job; the Queues & API screen (#/build-queues) shows them with the API accounts' keys, caps and spend (queues.mjs).

items.title: Build priorities
items.description: Every build's priority tag (Urgent, High, Normal, Low = P0-P3) and how many things wait on it.

items.title: What's waiting on a build
items.description: A build's priority and everything waiting for it: builds behind it in the agent queue, builds that depend on it, PRs stacked on it or behind it in the merge queue, UI Review items, linked plans. Say 'what's waiting on skins'.
items.output: { id, title, priority, label, waiting: [{ kind, id, title, why }] }

items.title: Headless runs and start tokens
items.description: A build's headless runs: start tokens (the context of the first request), cost, brief only or full chain, tools and MCP servers loaded. Say 'what did skins start with'.
items.output: { build, runs: [{ session, briefOnly, startTokens, startCostUsd, costUsd, at }] }

items.title: Set build priority
items.description: Set the priority of one or more builds: 'make banner widgets urgent'. Higher priority starts first in the agent queue and lands first in the merge queue; Brett's manual moves still win.

priority.description: urgent, high, normal, low or P0-P3

items.title: What Brett said
items.description: The verbatim words Brett used to start a build (build-origin@1): when, where, who launched it, the brief and later addenda.

items.title: Record what Brett said
items.description: Record Brett's verbatim words on a build that has none (backfilled ones give way); his words are never replaced: use origin-addendum for a later change.

said.description: Brett's exact words, verbatim and unedited (never a paraphrase)

items.title: Add what Brett said later
items.description: Append a later change Brett asked for (verbatim) to a build's origin.

said.description: Brett's exact words, verbatim and unedited (never a paraphrase)

items.title: Pipeline status
items.description: The build pipeline: what is Pending, in the Queue and Building, every Claude account (Fable yes or no, how many run on it), the agent slots, and what the dispatcher's next tick will start or why it waits. Say 'what's in the queue' or 'is anything building'.
items.output: { table: { pending, queued, building }, accounts, slots, plan: { launches, waits, idle }, state }

items.title: Queue a build
items.description: Move a Pending build to the Queue: the dispatcher starts it when a slot and an account for its model are free. Say 'queue the icon browser build'.

items.title: Take a build out of the Queue
items.description: Move a queued build back to Pending before it starts.

items.title: Split a build into steps
items.description: Ask the orchestrator to split (or re-split) a build into steps of 30 minutes or less, Fable only where needed; done by the dispatcher within a minute.

items.title: Queues and API jobs
items.description: Every build queue (Main, API and Brett's own lists) with its queued builds and live running jobs, Pending, each API account's key status (set or missing, never the value), caps and spend today and this week, the routing rules and what the next tick starts. Say 'what's in the API queue' or 'show my queues'.
items.output: { queues: [{ id, name, paused, uses, maxParallel, priority, costCapUsd, queued, running, stats }], pending, api, rules, approvals, asks, plan }

items.title: API spend
items.description: API accounts: key set or missing, on or off, spend today and this week against their caps; queue cost caps. Say 'how much have the API keys spent'.

items.title: Make a queue
items.description: Make a new queue list: name, which accounts it uses (subscriptions, API or both), max parallel, priority, default model, optional cost cap. Say 'make a queue called Night runs'.

uses.description: Which accounts the queue may use

maxParallel.description: Builds running at once from this queue

defaultModel.description: Model for steps with none pinned

costCapUsd.description: API spend cap per 24 h (0 = none). Raising it is Brett's click only

apiAccounts.description: API accounts it may use ([] = any)

subAccounts.description: Subscription accounts it may use ([] = any)

items.title: Change a queue's settings
items.description: Change any setting of a queue: accounts, max parallel, priority, default model, cost cap, paused, note. Lowering a cap is anyone's; raising one or giving a queue API accounts is Brett's own click.

uses.description: Which accounts the queue may use

maxParallel.description: Builds running at once from this queue

defaultModel.description: Model for steps with none pinned

costCapUsd.description: API spend cap per 24 h (0 = none). Raising it is Brett's click only

apiAccounts.description: API accounts it may use ([] = any)

subAccounts.description: Subscription accounts it may use ([] = any)

items.title: Rename a queue
items.description: Rename a queue list.

items.title: Reorder a queue
items.description: Move a queue list up, down, to the top or bottom, or to a place.

to.description: up, down, top, bottom or an index

items.title: Pause or resume a queue
items.description: Pause a queue (it starts nothing new; running jobs carry on) or resume it with paused false. Say 'pause the API queue'.

items.title: Delete a queue
items.description: Delete a queue list; its builds move to another queue (default the first subscription queue).

items.title: Put a build in a queue
items.description: Move a build from Pending into a queue, or from one queue to another. Say 'move the icon browser build to the API queue'.

items.title: Send a build back to Pending
items.description: Take a queued build out of its queue, back to Pending.

items.title: Edit a queue rule
items.description: Add, change, reorder, remove or switch on/off a queue rule: overflow {from, to} (subscriptions full sends work to the API queue), route {to, when: {categories, models}} (a build queued with no queue named goes there), max-cost {queue, maxCostUsd} (an API run that costs more is stopped). Switching a max-cost rule off or raising it is Brett's click only.

rule.description: Rule id, or the rule object for add

items.title: OK a build for an API key
items.description: Brett's OK for a build to run on an API key (billed per token), optionally with a max cost per run. Only Brett's own console click: anything else is refused and he is asked instead.

items.title: Withdraw an API OK
items.description: Withdraw a build's OK to run on API keys.
